source: Read-only audit + read-only compaction simulation, 2026-07-08 (approved for implementation same day)
notes: Controlled pose/body-language rotation so nearby renders do not repeat the same stance. Deliberately modeled on lena_expression_gaze_bank_v1.json's combo/compatibility_tags shape. Each entry is a short physical-stance modifier layered on top of (never overriding) the scene bank's own 'action' field. compatibility_tags intersect against LANE_POSE_TAG_ALLOWLIST in lena_prompt_brain.py (lane-level compatibility); reference_mode_tags intersect against the slot's chosen reference_mode. 'universal' entries are allowed on every lane. hand_risk flags entries that involve a hand action, for QA/reference and for lanes with an existing hand-risk sensitivity. attitude_level (2026-07-08, Visual Hook / Allure Gate follow-up) added to every combo (neutral/moderate/high), read by _pose_attitude_weight() in lena_prompt_brain.py as an additive selection-weight bonus -- never a hard filter. 6 new high-attitude combos (pose_p013-pose_p018) added: platform-safe confident-stance/hip-shift/wall-lean/three-quarter-angle/hair-touch/squared-posture directions, deliberately excluding over-the-shoulder and walking-stride attitude poses for this first pass (flagged as too unstable for a first attitude patch) and any heavy hand-object interaction.
